violations.why: Orchid is enabled by enable_isr(1) and can preempt the task between the check and the reset, so the reset can overwrite the increment.
Once orchid has run, it enables pylon with enable_isr(2). Pylon can then preempt the task between the check and the reset and update v_umber.
After the first orchid run, pylon is enabled and has higher priority. It can preempt a later orchid run in the middle of the v_umber++ read-modify-write, and its update is lost.
